decisions: Scope is the production spec and pre-spend audit, not rendering or media buying, so it works with Veo/Flow, Kling, Runway, HeyGen and image tools the buyer already pays for.
One brief produces six angles, video prompts, image ads, an avatar pack, captions and a claims ledger so the buyer gets a testable batch rather than one hero clip.
Every scene carries verbatim character, product, grade and craft blocks, and the audit fails the pack if any block is missing.
The audit is deterministic (38 weighted checks, no model judgement) and exits 1 unless the pack passes, so CI and agencies can gate spend.
AI/paid disclosure is mandatory for UGC styles; the HeyGen pack warns against presenting an AI actor as a real customer, per HeyGen's 2026 policy guidance.
India-first pricing at ₹2,999 / ₹6,999 / ₹14,999 with a ₹1,999 launch tier, positioned above copy-only audits and below an agency retainer.
unresolved: Owner approval for final pricing, license and publication.
